prompt: According to The Great Mental Models Vol 1, what are the key lessons of 'the map is not the territory' and 'circle of competence'? How do I operate outside my circle?
assertions: Map: reality is the ultimate update
Map: maps can influence territories (e.g., Jane Jacobs / city planners)
Circle: built/maintained with curiosity (desire to learn), monitoring track record, and feedback
Outside circle: learn the basics, talk to someone with strong competence, use broad mental models
Uses the Lifer vs Stranger illustration or mentions Korzybski
